# XLGD — umbrella index (llms.txt)

> X is a distinction mark. XLGD is the umbrella mark for the governance line:
> it fronts the theory (LGD) and the executable protocol (UIBC). MedXpert is a
> **parallel** application line, not inside the umbrella. All names are project
> identifiers only; no entity or trademark has been registered.

## Layers and repositories

- [LGD — theory](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-theory): Lifecycle
  Governance Doctrine. 凡自治之物 · 有籍 (registered) · 有证 (evidenced) · 有门禁 (gated).
  Formal text, citation entry, released versions.
- [UIBC — protocol](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/uibc-core): registry /
  evidence / gates reference implementation. Apache-2.0. `uibc demo` runs end to end.
- [silent-failure-catalog — verifier side](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/silent-failure-catalog):
  catalogue of silent-failure modes with negative controls.
- [uibc-competition — benchmark](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/uibc-competition).
- [agent-skills — agent integration](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/agent-skills).
- [lgd-hub — landing page](https://github.com/zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-hub): theory → skills → product → service.
- [MedXpert — applications (parallel)](https://medxpert.cn): medical-device
  regulatory line. Outside the umbrella.

## Machine-readable entry

- `ecosystem.json` — the umbrella index (layers, repositories, roles, licence, status).
- `CITATION.cff` — how to cite the umbrella.
